'''Joshua Ambercrest''' is a [[human]] located in the guard tower at [[Light's Point]] in the [[Scarlet Enclave]].

==Quotes==
Welcome to Light's Point, make yourself at home, should you not be tainted by either the plague of undeath, or the plague of zealotry.

The Scarlet Crusade that occupy the region are fervored in a bloodlust against all things, both living and dead. They view the world around them as hostile, and will need to be put down should the true light of what once was to shine through.
